name: r01b_four_holes_stay_where_they_are
why: THE ABSOLUTE TWIN of `r01_four_holes_from_the_border` (entry E18): the same four holes, without an anchor. It proves that the old way keeps working when it is what is wanted — holes that stay where they are because there is something there that corresponds to them, not because they are 20 from the edge.
intent_why: without an anchor x_mm/y_mm are coordinates of the model: raising the plate to 180 (from Y -60..+60 to -60..+120) the holes stay at y = +/-40.

after.tolerance_why: the cylinder axis is read from CylinderParams, which returns metres
